title: Widget "Network Speed": Several Display Styles do not show graphical changes in current down- and upload rates
line: The Network Speed widget's Horizontal Bars, Bar Chart and Color Grid styles now show the current rates against the last minute's peak instead of empty, full or fixed bars.
explanation: Rate sensors (network download/upload, disk read/write) have no fixed range, so they report a minimum and maximum of 0. With automatic range, Horizontal Bars used 0..0 and stayed empty, Color Grid divided by 0 and always used full color, and Bar Chart's automatic range in Kirigami Charts took the model's 0..0, so every bar was drawn full with '0 B/s' axis labels. A new shared type in the faces module, Faces.AutomaticRange, gives the three faces their automatic range: the sensor's own range when it has one, otherwise 0 up to the highest value of the last minute (the line chart's default history), so a burst stops dominating the scale a minute later; the range is never empty, so zero rates show as empty bars. Bar Chart feeds it the largest current value (the sum when stacked); sensors with a real range and manual ranges behave as before.

commits.message:
faces: scale bars to the recent peak for sensors without a range

Rate sensors like network speeds have a maximum of 0, so with automatic
range Horizontal Bars stayed empty, Bar Chart drew full bars and Color
Grid used full color. Scale them to the last minute's highest value.

BUG: 505409

patches.diff:
From 9d56266130ff20a1352a991e6f3a97d01a585a5a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:31:05 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] faces: scale bars to the recent peak for sensors without a
 range

Rate sensors like network speeds have a maximum of 0, so with automatic
range Horizontal Bars stayed empty, Bar Chart drew full bars and Color
Grid used full color. Scale them to the last minute's highest value.

BUG: 505409
---

 .../barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml         | 22 +++++-
 .../colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml      | 11 ++-
 .../horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml        | 12 ++-
 faces/import/AutomaticRange.qml               | 78 +++++++++++++++++++
 5 files changed, 118 insertions(+), 6 deletions(-)
 create mode 100644 faces/import/AutomaticRange.qml

diff --git a/faces/CMakeLists.txt b/faces/CMakeLists.txt
index 9c4d0e2c..11fcc14f 100644
--- a/faces/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/faces/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -39,6 +39,7 @@ ecm_add_qml_module(SensorFaces URI "org.kde.ksysguard.faces"
 )
 
 ecm_target_qml_sources(SensorFaces SOURCES
+    import/AutomaticRange.qml

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml b/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml
index 6fc1ae49..48e40389 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/barchart/contents/ui/BarChart.qml
@@ -42,9 +42,15 @@ Charts.BarChart {

-        from: chart.rangeFromY

+        from: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? automaticRange.from : chart.rangeFromY

+    }
+
+    Faces.AutomaticRange {
+        id: automaticRange
+        minimum: sensorsModel.minimum
+        maximum: sensorsModel.maximum
     }
 
     Sensors.SensorDataModel {
@@ -54,6 +60,16 @@ Charts.BarChart {
         sensorLabels: root.controller.sensorLabels
 
         property int unit: (sensorsModel.ready && sensorsModel.headerData(0, Qt.Horizontal, Sensors.SensorDataModel.Unit)) ?? Formatter.Units.UnitInvalid
+
+        onSensorsChanged: automaticRange.reset()

+                const sensorValue = sensorsModel.data(sensorsModel.index(0, i), Sensors.SensorDataModel.Value) ?? 0

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml b/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml
index 1dd00313..d8669686 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/colorgrid/contents/ui/SensorRect.qml
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
 import org.kde.ksysguard.formatter as Formatter
 import org.kde.ksysguard.sensors as Sensors
+import org.kde.ksysguard.faces as Faces
 
 Rectangle {
     id: rect
@@ -19,12 +20,20 @@ Rectangle {
     property alias text: label.text
     property color sensorColor
 
+    Faces.AutomaticRange {
+        id: automaticRange
+        value: rect.sensor?.value ?? 0
+        minimum: rect.sensor?.minimum ?? 0

-        opacity: (rect.sensor.value / rect.sensor.maximum)

diff --git a/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml b/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml
index d49ebd58..fb51338e 100644
--- a/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml
+++ b/faces/facepackages/horizontalbars/contents/ui/Bar.qml
@@ -31,8 +31,16 @@ ProgressBar {
     readonly property real rangeTo: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeTo * controller.faceConfiguration.rangeToMultiplier
 
     value: sensor?.value ?? 0
-    from: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? sensor.minimum : rangeFrom
-    to: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? sensor.maximum : rangeTo
+    from: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? automaticRange.from : rangeFrom
+    to: controller.faceConfiguration.rangeAuto ? automaticRange.to : rangeTo
+
+    Faces.AutomaticRange {
+        id: automaticRange
+        value: bar.sensor?.value ?? 0
+        minimum: bar.sensor?.minimum ?? 0
+        maximum: bar.sensor?.maximum ?? 0
+    }
+    onSensorChanged: automaticRange.reset()
 
     topPadding: topInset
     bottomPadding: bottomInset
diff --git a/faces/import/AutomaticRange.qml b/faces/import/AutomaticRange.qml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..54538fec
--- /dev/null
+++ b/faces/import/AutomaticRange.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+import QtQuick
+
+/**
+ * The automatic range of a sensor value for faces that show a single value
+ * against a range, like bars.
+ *
+ * Sensors with a fixed range use that range. Sensors without one, like
+ * network or disk rates, report the same minimum and maximum; for those the
+ * range goes up to the highest value of the last minute, like the line
+ * chart scales to the history it shows. The range is never empty, so
+ * that a value equal to the minimum shows as nothing rather than as full.
+ */
+QtObject {
+    id: range
+
+    /**
+     * The value to track, for example the sensor's value.
+     */
+    property real value
+    /**
+     * The sensor's own minimum.
+     */
+    property real minimum
+    /**
+     * The sensor's own maximum.
+     */
+    property real maximum
+    /**
+     * How long, in seconds, a value keeps the range up.
+     */
+    property int duration: 60
+
+    readonly property bool fixed: maximum > minimum
+
+    readonly property real from: minimum
+    readonly property real to: fixed ? maximum : (d.recentMaximum > minimum ? d.recentMaximum : minimum + 1)
+
+    /**
+     * Forget the values seen so far, for example when the sensor changes.
+     */
+    function reset() {
+        d.buckets = [value]
+        d.recentMaximum = value
+    }
+
+    Component.onCompleted: reset()
+
+    onValueChanged: {
+        const buckets = d.buckets
+        buckets[buckets.length - 1] = Math.max(buckets[buckets.length - 1], value)
+        d.buckets = buckets
+        d.recentMaximum = Math.max(d.recentMaximum, value)
+    }
+
+    property QtObject __private: QtObject {
+        id: d
+
+        property real recentMaximum
+        // Highest value seen in each tenth of the duration, oldest first
+        property var buckets: [0]
+
+        property Timer timer: Timer {
+            interval: range.duration * 100
+            running: !range.fixed
+            repeat: true
+            onTriggered: {
+                d.buckets = d.buckets.slice(-9).concat([range.value])
+                d.recentMaximum = Math.max(...d.buckets)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, three moments of a disk burst and then low load (rate sensors, same as network speed): Horizontal Bars stay empty, Bar Chart bars are full with every axis label 0 B/s, Color Grid is full color or nothing. Line chart for reference.

With the fix, same steps: bar lengths, Bar Chart heights and Color Grid strength follow the rates, and the scale is the last minute's peak: Bar Chart's axis matches the line chart's (1.0 GiB/s, then 857.5 MiB/s once older spikes leave the window). The rig's disk is shared with other test sessions, hence the frequent spikes.
The sweep tester's capture on master: empty Horizontal Bars and full Bar Chart bars at 10.2 MiB/s vs 0 B/s.
Regression check with the fix: sensors with a real range (CPU usage, used memory) on Horizontal Bars and Color Grid as before; Bar Chart with a manual 0–200 MiB/s range keeps it.

Regression check with the fix: stacked Bar Chart of rates scales to the recent peak like the line chart (113.2 vs 112.9 MiB/s); Bar Chart of CPU + memory keeps Kirigami Charts' own automatic range (unchanged mixed-unit axis).

review.text: The cause is that rate sensors report min = max = 0, so the bar-style faces had no usable automatic range. A single shared Faces.AutomaticRange type (the sensor's own range if it has one, otherwise the last minute's peak) fixes Horizontal Bars, Bar Chart and Color Grid consistently, and it matches what the line chart already does. Bounded sensors and manual ranges are untouched, which the regression shots confirm. The before/after media clearly show empty or full bars becoming proportional, with the Bar Chart axis matching the line chart. The scope and design choice are reasonable for libksysguard.
